evidence_refs: two intermittent failures localized by Root to UI draw scheduling and signal-guard ordering

root_hypotheses.F-final-draw: tests/ui/test_product_replay_independent_p27h.py intermittently shows the pane one row behind a synchronous pyte feed. Suspected: draw throttling while backlog exists (BACKLOG_FRAME_INTERVAL) can leave the last fed chunk undrawn when the backlog empties, until the next event/5 s snapshot. Required: whenever the backlog becomes empty (or on the first loop iteration after feeding the last byte), the screen is drawn promptly (<= one frame interval) - the displayed screen must never stay stale after output stops.
root_hypotheses.F-sigterm: src/workbench/ui/product/app.py loop(): `?2004h` is written before the try/finally that writes `?2004l`; a SIGTERM/SIGHUP (Terminate) arriving in that window leaves bracketed paste enabled. Required: enabling 2004 happens inside the protected region (or the restore is unconditional in the outer finally) so every exit path after enabling it restores it; the signal handlers are installed before any terminal mode change. Also make tests/ui/test_product_pty.py check_signal_restore wait until the UI has drawn (e.g. header visible) before sending the signal - asserting 2004l when 2004h was never written is a test error.
